items.title: Complete Protocol Parity Plan for GitHub Proxy in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive audit of the Chat Completions, Responses, and Messages protocols under the GitHub Proxy. Key changes include the registration of the plan in the authoritative index and the definition of a lossless protocol AST along with various implementation policies. The implementation will proceed as stacked PRs, ensuring thorough review before merging.

items.title: Enhance Studio Capability Flags in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update ensures that the `/intro` page correctly reflects the enabled capabilities for all sites, including `studio.acedata.cloud`. Key changes include improved loading states, accurate filtering of model and product cards, and the use of appropriate screenshots based on enabled features. The misleading 'models' statistic has been replaced with 'available products' for clarity.

items.title: Fix in-cluster client initialization for Helm deployment in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the in-cluster client was not explicitly initialized, causing connection errors during Helm operations. A new method, `get_k8s_networking_client()`, ensures that the Networking client is built only after the necessary configurations are loaded. The changes have been validated with 70 tests passing and a successful dry run on the discord-bot Ingress.

items.title: Final Implementation of Soft Cutoff Adjustments in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the deployment issues caused by the AKS admission webhook, which prevented multiple Ingress entries with the same host/path. Key changes include adding a 302 redirect for all tenant Ingress to the purchase page, ensuring platform availability during billing, and implementing a strategy for handling RBAC failures. The adjustments align with user expectations for site-wide interception during payment issues.

items.title: Fix Ingress Design Flaw for AKS Deployment in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue with the Ingress configuration that caused deployment failures in AKS due to duplicate host/path entries. The solution simplifies the design by implementing a 302 redirect to the renewal page, ensuring compliance with user requirements for site-wide blocking. Additionally, it resolves several gaps in the deployment process, enhancing overall stability and security.

items.title: Fix payment method handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where orders without a payment method were incorrectly categorized as 'Unknown', triggering false alarms in production metrics. The fix excludes null payment method entries during data aggregation and adds a regression test to ensure these orders do not affect alarm triggers. The changes improve the accuracy of payment health metrics and enhance overall system reliability.

items.title: Enhance Claude Code System Context Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the canonical system string with an ordered representation of `systemBlocks`, ensuring that Anthropic `cache_control` metadata is preserved during Messages routing. It promotes text-only Claude Code `system` and `developer` entries before validation, while maintaining strict error handling for unknown roles and non-text blocks. Overall, these changes improve the robustness and clarity of system context management.

items.title: Enhance openai CLI with latest API updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the `openai` CLI package with the latest changes from the upstream Docs/OpenAPI. Key improvements include updated command mappings, request schema parity, and corrected endpoint paths, all while maintaining backward compatibility for existing users.

items.title: Align OpenAI MCP Server with Latest Docs Updates in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the OpenAI MCP server with the latest OpenAPI contract from AceDataCloud/Docs. Key changes include updates to provider/model enum coverage, request parameter shapes, and endpoint path mappings to ensure spec/code parity while maintaining backward compatibility. The existing MCP server architecture remains intact, with new support added without removing legacy paths.

items.title: OpenAI CLI Verified for Docs Sync in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The OpenAI CLI has been thoroughly checked against the latest `openapi/openai.json` specification, confirming that no code changes are necessary. All supported endpoints, request fields, option mappings, and model enums have been validated, ensuring alignment with the current documentation. This update maintains the integrity of the CLI without any file modifications.

items.title: Sync suno with Docs OpenAPI and update CLI help text in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the `suno` service is in sync with the latest OpenAPI specifications, addressing a stale default model in the CLI help text. The only change made was updating the `SUNO_DEFAULT_MODEL` from `chirp-v4-5` to `chirp-v5-5`, ensuring accurate documentation without altering any code paths or tool signatures.

items.title: Enhance auto sizing for semantic canvas in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update documents the continuous-ratio semantic canvas planning for explicit `size=auto`, detailing how the platform prioritizes various standards and conventions. It clarifies support for non-preset ratios and ensures deterministic normalization to a 16-pixel grid. The changes improve the handling of image sizes, retaining fail-open behavior while distinguishing between explicit `auto` and omitted sizes.

items.title: Enhance Auto Size Classification for Images in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new classification system for `size=auto` prompts using `gpt-5.6-luna`, allowing for a continuous aspect ratio instead of fixed sizes. Key improvements include validation against common standards, normalization to provider limits, and async task handling for better performance. The implementation has been tested across multiple services, ensuring consistency and accuracy in image sizing.

items.title: Enhance Cached Token Assertions in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update strengthens the cached-token recorder by ensuring that cached details are populated before both non-stream and streaming price calculations. Additionally, it verifies that the cost object is correctly injected into the response usage. The changes have passed focused usage tests and the full OpenAI worker suite, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Enhance Reasoning Summaries and Model IDs in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update preserves the `reasoning.summary` through canonical routing and emits the complete official reasoning-summary SSE lifecycle. Additionally, it normalizes display-only `[1m]` suffixes from public `/v1/models` IDs while maintaining internal capability discovery. These changes improve the clarity and usability of model IDs and enhance the overall response handling.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Response Billing Accuracy in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the accuracy of billing for OpenAI responses by reading authoritative usage data from the response stream. Key changes include preserving cached token details in JSON and streaming records, along with adding regression tests for both non-streaming and real-shape streaming usage. The adjustments aim to ensure that billing reflects actual usage more accurately, addressing previous discrepancies.

items.title: Enhance Messages Reference Parity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a configurable live differential suite for Anthropic Messages, allowing for comprehensive comparisons of non-stream fields and tool usage. Key changes include aligning synthesized Message objects with nullable fields and ensuring optional reference credentials for CI and forks. The validation process confirmed 83 tests passed with no failures, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Updated Model Mappings for Claude in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new mappings for Claude families to their respective GPT fallback tiers. Key changes include routing `kimi-k3`, `claude-fable-5`, and `claude-opus-5` to `gpt-5.6-sol`, while Opus 4.5-4.8 aliases now point to `gpt-5.5`. The complete mapping is maintained in `modelAliases.js`, ensuring consistency across production environments.

items.title: Update Suno Consumption Rates to 0.56 Credits in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update normalizes the remaining Suno consumption rates from 0.55 to 0.56 credits across various rules, including extend, underpainting, and artist consistency. The API billing and service display pricing have been aligned accordingly, ensuring no 0.55 values remain in the billing files. All related tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Soft Cutoff for Expired Deployments in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update extends the grace period for expired deployments from 3 to 7 days, allowing workloads to continue running without interruption. It introduces a soft cutoff mechanism that enables immediate unblocking upon payment, eliminating the need to wait for cron jobs. Additionally, the PR includes comprehensive tests to ensure compatibility and proper handling of various states.

items.title: Ensure Suno CLI Sync with Documentation in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the Suno CLI is fully synchronized with the latest documentation updates. All endpoints, actions, models, and request parameters have been confirmed to align with the current OpenAPI contract. Notably, the recent changes in the documentation were purely content updates, requiring no modifications to the CLI or tests.

items.title: Update Suno MCP for OpenAPI Sync in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the Suno MCP server with the latest OpenAPI changes, focusing on API-surface parity within the `suno/` package. Key enhancements include updated request parameter handling, model and enum coverage, and consistent response mapping to match current documentation. Backward compatibility is preserved while integrating new fields for improved functionality.

items.title: Optimize Suno Consumption Rates in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reduces Suno generation and consumption costs from 0.77 to 0.56 credits, and all stems consumption from 2.2 to 1.6 credits. The changes ensure that API billing and service display pricing remain aligned, while also updating relevant cost assertions. Comprehensive testing has confirmed that all related tests passed successfully.

items.title: Enhanced Security Measures for Account Verification in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical vulnerabilities in account verification processes by refining the detection of fraudulent signups. Key changes include stricter rules for local-part username formats and improved conditions for identifying suspicious account patterns. The modifications aim to enhance the overall security and integrity of the authentication system.

items.title: Enhance Subscription Status Handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update integrates subscription status directly from the backend, ensuring accurate representation of states like 'suspended' and 'reclaimed'. The BillingBar component has been refactored to eliminate hardcoded values and now displays relevant information for all subscription types, improving user experience. Additionally, internationalization has been updated to support new status messages across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance Ingress Traffic Control for Expired Tenants in Backend 🚦
items.summary: This update introduces a soft cutoff capability for Ingress traffic, allowing expired tenants to be redirected without stopping their workloads. Key changes include the implementation of a new method for blocking traffic at the Ingress level while preserving the runtime state of applications. The modifications ensure that expired tenants can renew their services seamlessly, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

items.title: Upgrade Python Setup Action to Version 7 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the actions/setup-python from version 5 to 7 across the workflow files. Key enhancements include migration to ESM, improved error handling, and updated documentation. These changes will enhance the reliability and performance of Python setup in our CI/CD processes.

items.title: Enhance API Compliance with OpenAI Standards in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns our API response fields with the official OpenAI API by addressing five key discrepancies. Notable fixes include correcting the Responses stream to avoid sending extra `[DONE]` signals and adding missing fields like `instructions` and `service_tier`. A new test suite has been introduced to ensure ongoing compliance and catch any future discrepancies.

items.title: Reprioritize Channels for Better Output Quality in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: The channel order for nano-banana has been updated to prioritize mountsea over cqtai, improving output quality. This change affects both the `/nano-banana` and `/nano-banana/tasks` routes while keeping all policies unchanged. The deployment script has also been corrected to reflect this new order, ensuring consistency across configurations.
